notes: None starts no optional restoration. Minimal prioritizes small preparedness references and radio-study materials.
Recommended adds forms, family resources, resilience references, iFixit and WikiMed when selected in the saved profile.
Full includes all enabled saved packages; disabled selections remain disabled.
Recipe footprints must be bounded in the exported profile. Unknown sizes disable approval, rather than being counted as zero.
Sizes are conservative estimates, with staging space, update headroom and a 10 GiB minimum reserve.
